market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CME Crude Oil settlement currently near $100 with Strait of Hormuz disruption supporting prices. EIA forecasts elevated prices through Q2; settlement dropping to $80 requires ~20% drop with Hormuz reopening fully. Possible but not base case.
data_sources: EIA April 2026 STEO Brent peak Q2 $115/b
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of Strait of Hormuz reopening and demand response
